study.title: Public Perceptions of Polygenic Testing and Embryo Selection for Non-Medical Traits
study.notes: Post-cutoff forecast (results public after the kernel's 2026-01-01 cutoff), not prospective: the Stage 1 protocol with pilot results was public from 2025-10, and the forecaster saw headline results in search snippets before building it (the kernel's outputs are mechanical). Implantation task only (Study 1a, US), approximated by the 9 trade-off dilemmas per attribute pair in both positions; the willingness question's wording is in Supplementary Fig. 1, which we do not have.
